name.text: Shared: Read missing coordinates from two linear graphs

questiontext.text:
Two linear relations, Relation A and Relation B, are shown on the Cartesian plane.

Use the graph to complete the two ordered pairs.

[[jsxgraph]] JXG.Options.text.useMathJax = true; var board = JXG.JSXGraph.initBoard( divid, { axis: true, showCopyright: false, boundingbox: [-6,6,6,-6], keepaspectratio: true, grid: true } ); var lineA = board.create( 'functiongraph', [ function(x) { return {#m1#}*x + {#c1#}; } ], { fixed: true, strokeWidth: 3 } ); var lineB = board.create( 'functiongraph', [ function(x) { return {#m2#}*x + {#c2#}; } ], { fixed: true, strokeWidth: 3, dash: 2 } ); board.create( 'point', [{#xA#},{#yA#}], { name: 'A', fixed: true, size: 4, showInfobox: false } ); board.create( 'point', [{#xB#},{#yB#}], { name: 'B', fixed: true, size: 4, showInfobox: false } ); board.unsuspendUpdate(); [[/jsxgraph]]

Point \(A\) lies on Relation A: \[ A=({@xA@},\, ?) \] The missing \(y\)-coordinate is [[input:ans1]] [[validation:ans1]]

Point \(B\) lies on Relation B: \[ B=(?,\, {@yB@}) \] The missing \(x\)-coordinate is [[input:ans2]] [[validation:ans2]]

[[feedback:prt1]] [[feedback:prt2]]

generalfeedback.text:
Worked solution

For point \(A\), read the vertical coordinate of the marked point on Relation A.

Therefore, \[ A=({@xA@},{@yA@}). \]

For point \(B\), read the horizontal coordinate of the marked point on Relation B.

Therefore, \[ B=({@xB@},{@yB@}). \]

Remember that an ordered pair is written as \[ (x,y). \] The horizontal coordinate comes first and the vertical coordinate comes second.

questiondescription.text:
Shared Curriculum-Independent Question Bank

QLIN-07

linear-relations

coordinate-graphs

conceptual

missing-ordered-pair-from-graph

Learners read two fixed linear graphs and complete missing coordinates in ordered pairs.

Unlike QLIN-05 and QLIN-06, learners do not construct the lines. They must interpret already-drawn graph information and distinguish horizontal and vertical coordinates.

Adapted from the straight-line graph question family represented by Numbas question NUMBAS-17290, "Graphs I: Linear - Line equation", licensed CC BY 4.0. The STACK implementation uses new wording, generated values, a two-relation missing-coordinate interaction and diagnostic feedback.

https://numbas.mathcentre.ac.uk/question/17290/

node.description: Checks the missing y-coordinate for A.

truefeedback.text: Correct. You read the vertical coordinate of point A correctly.

node.description: Detects use of Relation B for point A.

truefeedback.text: That value matches Relation B at the given \(x\)-coordinate. Point A belongs to Relation A. Read the vertical coordinate from the Relation A graph.
You appear to have used the \(x\)-coordinate. Ordered pairs are written as \((x,y)\). The missing value for A is the vertical \(y\)-coordinate.

falsefeedback.text: Check point A on Relation A and read its vertical coordinate carefully.

node.description: Checks the missing x-coordinate for B.

truefeedback.text: Correct. You read the horizontal coordinate of point B correctly.

node.description: Detects use of Relation A for point B.

truefeedback.text: That value corresponds to Relation A at the shown \(y\)-coordinate. Point B belongs to Relation B. Read the horizontal coordinate from the Relation B graph.
You appear to have used the \(y\)-coordinate. Ordered pairs are written as \((x,y)\). The missing value for B is the horizontal \(x\)-coordinate.

falsefeedback.text: Check point B on Relation B and read its horizontal coordinate carefully.

qtest.description: Both missing coordinates should receive full credit.
